preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10,000, inclusive.
The number of permutations in each test case is between 1 and 50,000, inclusive.
The length of each permutation is between 1 and 10, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: Each permutation contains distinct integers from 1 to m.
preconditions.description: Each permutation consists of unique integers between 1 and m.

preconditions.expression: The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 5 * 10^4.
preconditions.description: The total number of permutations across all test cases does not exceed 50,000.

postconditions.expression: The output contains t lines, each with n integers.
postconditions.description: Each line contains the largest beauty of a permutation a_i * a_j for all j from 1 to n.
